mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM branches WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS branches, (SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE status <> 'DELETED') AS total_customers, (SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_customers, (SELECT count(*) FROM staff_users WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_staff

SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.email, u.display_name, u.status, u.totp_enabled_at IS NOT NULL AS totp_enabled, u.last_login_at, u.created_at FROM staff_users u JOIN staff_roles r ON r.staff_user_id = u.id WHERE r.role = 'COMPANY_OWNER' ORDER BY u.created_at
